chapters.title: 01 / Good ideas. Great company.
chapters.text: One workspace for teams, organizers, and judges.

chapters.title: 02 / The whole event, at a glance
chapters.text: Real project counts, review progress, and clear next steps.

chapters.title: 03 / Make room for your next event
chapters.text: Set the dates, tracks, and prizes with custom clay controls.

chapters.title: 04 / Build a team. Tell your story.
chapters.text: Draft your project before sharing it with the event.

chapters.title: 05 / Ready to share

chapters.text: Assign a balanced batch and keep track of completed reviews.

chapters.text: Use the weighted rubric and leave useful feedback.

chapters.title: 08 / Publish a result everyone can trust
chapters.text: After the deadline, freeze the scores and export the results.

chapters.title: 09 / Celebrate the work
chapters.text: Visitors can explore projects and read the published scores.

chapters.title: 10 / A little room to play
chapters.text: Six arcade games. Your high scores stay in this browser.

chapters.title: DOGFOOD / Make something that matters
chapters.text: Build together. Review thoughtfully. Keep everything moving.
